cheats.name: Weightless Fuel
cheats.note: Code-supported: FuelTank.UpdatePart and FuelTank.GetPartStats both read [container+0x80] (fuelWeight) from the PlaneContainer singleton. Field resolves live at 0.4. Not run in-game.

cheats.name: Low Drag
cheats.note: Code-supported: DragSimulator.CalculateDragFactor multiplies its result by this+0x4C (dragMultiplier). Field resolves live at 1.2. Not run in-game.
